meta.title: Colorado rules behind the LIHTC guide's deal-killers
meta.purpose: The facts the LIHTC stakeholder guide states for each Colorado deal-killer. test/colorado-guide-detail.test.js checks the guide against these fields.

rules.label: Water.
rules.finding: A local government may not approve a development permit for a project adding more than 50 single-family equivalents of new water use, or a lower number it sets, until it finds the water supply adequate.

rules.label: Contamination.
rules.finding: CDPHE approves or disapproves a voluntary cleanup plan within 45 days; a No Action Determination is a separate petition for sites below standards or contaminated from a neighboring property. Review is billed by the hour.

rules.label: Proposition 123 status.
rules.finding: Most state Prop 123 money requires a local commitment on file; Office of Homeless Initiatives programs and modular/factory-built manufacturer loans are exempt.

rules.label: Local right of first refusal.
rules.finding: A local government may match an offer on existing affordable rental property of five or more units; a seller pursuing a public-program resyndication or recapitalization is exempt after notice and evidence. The rights end on the record's sunset date.
